story.headline: Notre Dame takes control late, tops Boston College 49-36
body: Notre Dame asserted control when it mattered in a 49-36 win over Boston College in Week 13 PCFL action.
The Fighting Irish outgained Boston College 453–234 in total offense, including 131 yards on the ground. Boston College kept fighting, managing 234 total yards on the night.
Up next, Notre Dame travels to face Texas in Week 14.

story.headline: Tennessee pulls away from LSU, 39-20
body: Tennessee asserted control when it mattered in a 39-20 win over LSU in Week 13 PCFL action.
The Volunteers outgained LSU 452–348 in total offense, including 113 yards on the ground. LSU kept fighting, managing 348 total yards on the night.
Up next, Tennessee hosts Arkansas in Week 14.

story.headline: Arkansas outlasts Ohio State in 30-25 battle
body: Arkansas found just enough in a 30-25 win over Ohio State in Week 13 PCFL action.
The Razorbacks were outgained by Ohio State 437–308 in total offense, including 72 yards on the ground. Ohio State kept fighting, managing 437 total yards on the night.
Up next, Arkansas travels to face Tennessee in Week 14.

story.headline: Instant classic: Texas edges UCLA, 22-20
body: Texas found just enough in a 22-20 thriller over UCLA in Week 13 PCFL action.
The Longhorns were outgained by UCLA 316–289 in total offense, including 36 yards on the ground. UCLA kept fighting, managing 316 total yards on the night.
Up next, Texas hosts Notre Dame in Week 14.
